blocks.zh: 2. Personnel Training and Evaluation | 人員訓練與評估
blocks.en: 2. Personnel Training and Evaluation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何 GFT 用「兩隻手總和」而非單手？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Does GFT Use the Sum of Both Hands Rather Than One Hand?

blocks.zh: Gloved Fingertip and Thumb Sampling, GFT (戴手套指尖採樣)：以 TSA 培養基接觸戴手套的雙手指尖，評估更衣過程是否維持手套無菌性的測試。
blocks.en: Gloved Fingertip and Thumb Sampling (GFT): A test in which the fingertips of both gloved hands are pressed onto TSA media to assess whether the garbing process has maintained the sterility of the gloves.

blocks.zh: USP 將兩隻手的菌落計算合計，原因是即使只有一隻手污染，在操作時仍可能交叉感染另一隻手或污染 CSP。合計計算比單手更嚴格，更符合實際風險邏輯。
blocks.en: USP counts the colonies from both hands together, because even if only one hand is contaminated, it can still cross-contaminate the other hand or the CSP during manipulations. Counting the total is stricter than counting a single hand and better matches the real risk logic.

blocks.zh: GFT 關鍵數字總覽
blocks.en: GFT Key Numbers at a Glance

blocks.zh:
初始合格標準：連續 3 次通過（任一次失敗需重新計算）
更衣後：兩手合計 = 0 cfu（任何菌落即為失敗）
Media-fill 後：兩手合計 ≤ 3 cfu 為通過

持續訓練頻率：
  Category 1 & 2 人員 → 每 6 個月 1 次
  Category 3 人員     → 每 3 個月 1 次
  監督人員（不操作）  → 每 12 個月 1 次
blocks.en:
Initial qualification criterion: 3 consecutive passes (any failure requires the count to be restarted)
After garbing: total for both hands = 0 cfu (any colony is a failure)
After media-fill: total for both hands ≤ 3 cfu is a pass

Ongoing training frequency:
  Category 1 & 2 personnel → once every 6 months
  Category 3 personnel       → once every 3 months
  Supervisory personnel (not compounding) → once every 12 months

blocks.zh: 重點提示：最嚴格規定 — 更衣後 GFT 為 >0 即失敗
blocks.en: Key Point: The Strictest Rule - Any Result > 0 After Garbing Is a Failure

blocks.zh: 更衣後的 GFT 動作水準是 >0，意即任何菌落計數都代表失敗。這比 media-fill 後的 >3 標準嚴格得多。
blocks.en: The action level for GFT after garbing is >0, meaning any colony count is a failure. This is much stricter than the >3 criterion after media-fill.

blocks.zh: 邏輯：更衣過程本身應完全無菌；media-fill 則是模擬實際操作，允許微量但極低的風險。
blocks.en: The logic: the garbing process itself should be completely sterile; media-fill simulates actual operations, which allows a small but very low risk.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的刷手標準
blocks.en: Analogy: The Surgical Scrub Standard in the Operating Room

blocks.zh: GFT 就像外科醫師術前刷手後的無菌確認。外科團隊不會在完成刷手後、進入手術室前，就讓手接觸非無菌物品。同樣地，藥師在完成更衣程序後，必須確保手套指尖「零污染」——這是進入 CSP 調配區前的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: GFT is like the sterility check a surgeon performs after scrubbing before surgery. After finishing the scrub and before entering the operating room, a surgical team would never let their hands touch nonsterile items. Likewise, after finishing the garbing procedure, a pharmacist must ensure "zero contamination" on the gloved fingertips; this is the last line of defense before entering the CSP compounding area.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：文件記錄要求
blocks.en: Practical Application: Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 失敗記錄必須包含：(1) 受評人員姓名、(2) 評估日期和時間、(3) 培養基廠商/效期/批號、(4) 各培養週期起始溫度、(5) 培養日期、(6) 結果、(7) 觀察者及讀板人身份。
blocks.en: A failure record must include: (1) the name of the person evaluated, (2) the date and time of the evaluation, (3) the media manufacturer, expiration date and lot number, (4) the starting temperature of each incubation period, (5) the incubation dates, (6) the results, and (7) the identity of the observer and of the person who read the plates.

blocks.zh: 任何失敗必須有矯正行動記錄。此記錄不只是合規文件，也是人員能力的長期評估依據。
blocks.en: Every failure must have a corrective action record. This record is not only a compliance document but also a long-term basis for assessing personnel competence.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某調配人員第一次和第二次通過 GFT，但第三次失敗，之後第四次通過。她是否已完成初始合格評估？
blocks.en: A compounder passes GFT the first and second times, fails the third time, and then passes the fourth time. Has she completed the initial qualification?

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 調配人員的 GFT 頻率比 Category 1/2 頻繁，為什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the GFT frequency for Category 3 CSP compounders higher than for Category 1/2?

blocks.zh: GFT 時，為何不能在接觸培養基前先噴 70% IPA？
blocks.en: Why must 70% IPA not be sprayed on the hands before they touch the media during GFT?

blocks.zh: 2.3 Competency Testing in Aseptic Manipulation | 無菌操作能力測試
blocks.en: 2.3 Competency Testing in Aseptic Manipulation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Media-Fill Test 的設計原理
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Design Principle of the Media-Fill Test

blocks.zh: Media-Fill Test (培養基充填測試)：以微生物培養基取代實際藥品，模擬最困難的調配程序。如果過程中有任何污染，培養基會呈現混濁，提供直接可見的證據。
blocks.en: Media-Fill Test: Microbial growth media is used in place of the actual drug to simulate the most challenging compounding procedure. If any contamination occurs during the process, the media becomes turbid, providing direct visible evidence.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設計原則：「必須模擬最困難的程序」——若藥師通常調配含多次針頭刺穿的複雜配方，media-fill 就必須模擬相同難度，而非僅用簡單的單次操作。
blocks.en: The key design principle: "the most challenging procedure must be simulated." If a pharmacist normally compounds complex formulations involving multiple needle punctures, the media-fill must simulate the same level of difficulty, not just a simple single manipulation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Media-Fill 如同飛行模擬器
blocks.en: Analogy: Media-Fill Is Like a Flight Simulator

blocks.zh: 飛行員在執行真實飛行前，必須在模擬機中通過最惡劣天氣的測試。Media-fill 就是調配人員的「飛行模擬器」——用培養基代替真實藥品，在相同的操作環境和壓力下測試無菌技術。
blocks.en: Before flying real aircraft, a pilot must pass a test in the simulator under the worst weather conditions. Media-fill is the compounder's "flight simulator": growth media replaces the real drug, and aseptic technique is tested in the same operating environment and under the same pressure.

blocks.zh: 若模擬機測試失敗（培養基混濁），就不應讓此人進行真實操作（調配患者用藥）。
blocks.en: If the simulator test fails (the media becomes turbid), the person should not be allowed to perform real operations (compounding medication for patients).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：三層測試的邏輯順序
blocks.en: Key Point: The Logical Sequence of the Three Layers of Testing

blocks.zh: 完整的無菌操作能力評估包含三層：
blocks.en: A complete assessment of aseptic manipulation competency has three layers:

blocks.zh: ①視覺觀察：評估員目視確認操作行為是否正確
blocks.en: (1) Visual observation: an evaluator visually confirms that the manipulations are performed correctly

blocks.zh: ②Media-fill：實際模擬操作，用培養基檢驗污染
blocks.en: (2) Media-fill: an actual simulated operation, with growth media used to test for contamination

blocks.zh: ③GFT + 表面採樣：Media-fill 完成後立即採樣，確認殘餘手套污染狀況
blocks.en: (3) GFT + surface sampling: sampling immediately after the media-fill to confirm the residual glove contamination status

blocks.zh: 任何一層失敗 = 整體評估失敗。三層同時成立才能獨立操作。
blocks.en: Failure of any one layer = failure of the overall assessment. All three layers must be passed before the person may work independently.

blocks.zh: Media-Fill 培養條件
blocks.en: Media-Fill Incubation Conditions

blocks.zh:
培養條件（必須兩種溫度）：
  30°–35°：最少 7 天（細菌優化條件）
  20°–25°：最少 7 天（黴菌/酵母菌優化條件）
  → 共最少 14 天培養週期

判定標準：
  任何容器在 14 天前出現混濁 = FAIL
  所有容器均清澈（plus 陽性對照生長） = PASS
blocks.en:
Incubation conditions (both temperatures are required):
  30°–35°C: minimum 7 days (optimized for bacteria)
  20°–25°C: minimum 7 days (optimized for molds/yeasts)
  → a minimum total incubation period of 14 days

Acceptance criteria:
  Any container turbid before 14 days = FAIL
  All containers clear (plus growth in the positive control) = PASS

blocks.zh: 實務應用：非無菌原料的 Media-Fill 設計
blocks.en: Practical Application: Media-Fill Design for Nonsterile Components

blocks.zh: 當調配從非無菌原料（如 API 粉末）開始的 Category 2/3 CSP 時，media-fill 必須用「非無菌大豆酪蛋白消化培養基粉末」配製 3% 溶液，模擬從粉末溶解到過濾滅菌的完整流程。此時必須包含陽性對照組以確認培養基仍有促生長能力。
blocks.en: When compounding a Category 2/3 CSP that starts from nonsterile components (such as API powder), the media-fill must use a 3% solution of nonsterile soybean-casein digest medium powder, simulating the whole process from dissolving the powder to filter sterilization. A positive control must be included to confirm that the medium can still support growth.

blocks.zh: Category 3 人員的 media-fill 頻率（每3個月）比 Category 1/2（每6個月）更頻繁，其理由是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the media-fill frequency for Category 3 personnel (every 3 months) higher than for Category 1/2 (every 6 months)?

blocks.zh: 若 media-fill 的陽性對照組沒有出現混濁，這個測試的結果是否有效？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the positive control of a media-fill does not become turbid, is the result of the test valid? Why?

blocks.zh: 一位調配監督人員（不直接調配）需要進行 media-fill 測試嗎？頻率為何？
blocks.en: Does a compounding supervisor (who does not compound directly) need to perform a media-fill test? How often?

blocks.zh: 3. Personal Hygiene and Garbing | 個人衛生與更衣
blocks.en: 3. Personal Hygiene and Garbing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：人體是最大的微生物來源
blocks.en: Core Concept: People Are the Largest Source of Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 每小時脫落超過 100 萬個鱗狀細胞——每個細胞都附著微生物。這就是為什麼更衣程序是無菌製造中最關鍵的污染控制環節之一。
blocks.en: A person sheds more than 1 million squamous cells per hour, and each cell carries microorganisms. This is why the garbing procedure is one of the most critical contamination control steps in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Garbing (更衣)：覆蓋人體以減少皮膚脫屑和微生物散佈的防護程序。目的不是保護人，而是保護 CSP 不被人污染。
blocks.en: Garbing: The protective procedure of covering the body to reduce skin shedding and the spread of microorganisms. Its purpose is not to protect the person but to protect the CSP from contamination by the person.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的外科洗手服
blocks.en: Analogy: Surgical Scrubs in the Operating Room

blocks.zh: 手術室裡的更衣規定有相同邏輯：外科醫師換上刷手服、戴手術帽、戴口罩，是為了防止身上的微生物落入開放的手術傷口，而非為了個人保護。
blocks.en: The garbing rules in an operating room follow the same logic: surgeons put on scrubs, a surgical cap and a mask to prevent microorganisms on their bodies from falling into the open surgical wound, not for their own protection.

blocks.zh: 無菌調配室的更衣程序本質相同——「穿對的衣服，是為了保護病人」。
blocks.en: The garbing procedure in a sterile compounding room is essentially the same: "wearing the right clothing is to protect the patient."

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Category 3 的更衣是針對整個緩衝室，不只針對調配當天
blocks.en: Key Point: Category 3 Garbing Applies to the Entire Buffer Room, Not Only to the Day of Compounding

blocks.zh: Category 3 的額外更衣要求（無露出皮膚、全無菌外衣）適用於進入 Category 3 緩衝室的所有人員，無論當天是否調配 Category 3 CSP。
blocks.en: The additional Category 3 garbing requirements (no exposed skin, fully sterile outer garments) apply to all personnel entering a Category 3 buffer room, whether or not they compound a Category 3 CSP that day.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：若你的設施在同一緩衝室混合調配 Category 2 和 Category 3，所有進入此緩衝室的人都必須符合 Category 3 更衣標準——這顯著提高了運作成本。
blocks.en: This means that if your facility compounds both Category 2 and Category 3 in the same buffer room, everyone entering that buffer room must meet the Category 3 garbing standard, which significantly raises operating costs.

blocks.zh: Cat 1/2 vs Cat 3 更衣差異對比
blocks.en: Garbing Differences: Cat 1/2 vs. Cat 3

blocks.zh:
Category 1 & 2:
  低纖維防護衣（袖口密合、覆頸）
  鞋套、頭套（含耳部）、口罩
  無菌無粉手套
  → 可重複使用（同班次）

Category 3 (額外要求):
  + 臉部和頸部必須覆蓋（無外露皮膚）
  + 所有外層衣物必須無菌
  + 一次性衣物不可重複使用
  + 洗滌衣物需再次滅菌驗證後方可使用
blocks.en:
Category 1 & 2:
  Low-shedding coverall (tight cuffs, covers the neck)
  Shoe covers, head cover (including ears), face mask
  Sterile, powder-free gloves
  → may be reused (within the same shift)

Category 3 (additional requirements):
  + Face and neck must be covered (no exposed skin)
  + All outer garments must be sterile
  + Single-use garments must not be reused
  + Laundered garments must be re-sterilized and validated before use
